experience.elderlexicon.igni_cold: You feel the cold for real.
experience.elderlexicon.igni_hypothermia: The cold gets into your bones.
experience.elderlexicon.igni_warm: You feel the heat for real.
experience.elderlexicon.burning: You know what it is to burn.
experience.elderlexicon.freezing: You know what it is to freeze.
understood.elderlexicon.igni: You understand heat whole: not the word, but what it is. Perhaps you will dream of it.
dream.elderlexicon.enter.igni: A vivid dream pulls you into yourself. Everything here burns.
experience.elderlexicon.aqua_parched: Thirst cracks your mouth from within.
experience.elderlexicon.aqua_full: You feel the water weighing in your body.
experience.elderlexicon.drowning: You know what it is to drown.
experience.elderlexicon.swept: You know what it is to be carried by the current.
experience.elderlexicon.aura_low: Air is lacking in your chest.
experience.elderlexicon.aura_critical: You draw breath and none comes.
experience.elderlexicon.aura_high: Air runs too fast through you.
experience.elderlexicon.long_fall: You know what it is to fall, the air tearing around you.
experience.elderlexicon.blast: You felt the breath of a blast.
experience.elderlexicon.firmo_deficient: Your body cannot hold itself up.
experience.elderlexicon.firmo_high: You feel the earth weighing in your bones.
experience.elderlexicon.buried: You know what it is to be buried.
experience.elderlexicon.depths: You feel the weight of all the earth above you.
understood.elderlexicon.aqua: You understand water completely: what flows, what dissolves, what drowns. Perhaps you will dream of it.
understood.elderlexicon.aura: You understand air completely: breath, pressure, what the wind carries. Perhaps you will dream of it.
understood.elderlexicon.firmo: You understand earth completely: the weight, the mineral, what holds and what buries. Perhaps you will dream of it.
dream.elderlexicon.enter.aqua: A vivid dream pulls you into yourself. Everything here is wet.
dream.elderlexicon.enter.aura: A vivid dream pulls you into yourself. Here the air never stops.
dream.elderlexicon.enter.firmo: A vivid dream pulls you into yourself. Everything here weighs.
experience.elderlexicon.vis_empty: You know what it is to have no mana left at all.
experience.elderlexicon.vis_full: You feel the mana brimming over in you.
experience.elderlexicon.vis_balance: The four sources are in balance in your body.
understood.elderlexicon.vis: You understand vis completely: the four sources in one, what is too much and what is lacking. Perhaps you will dream of it.
dream.elderlexicon.enter.vis: A vivid dream pulls you into yourself. Here everything is everything at once.
dream.elderlexicon.woke_unlearned: You wake with a start, having learned nothing.
message.elderlexicon.trance_woken: You wake up sick. For a moment, deep in your sleep, something heard you. You can enter the trance.
tower.elderlexicon.enter: You died. Your spirit wakes in Nahvá, before a tower without end.
tower.elderlexicon.floor.0: The antechamber. Nothing is lacking here.
tower.elderlexicon.road: The road is long. When you raise your eyes, Lig'dar stands before you.
tower.elderlexicon.floor.summit: The top. The rift is waiting.
tower.elderlexicon.room.combat: Those who came before are still here.
tower.elderlexicon.room.puzzle: The wall shows what the hand must do.
tower.elderlexicon.room.descent: There are no stairs going up.
tower.elderlexicon.room.memory: You know this place. But something is not as you left it.
tower.elderlexicon.room.mirror: The one on the other side does everything you do. Only later.
tower.elderlexicon.room.speech: A dead tongue asks for a living word.
tower.elderlexicon.lent: The tower lends you, for as long as the climb lasts: %s
kern.elderlexicon.enter: You died. Your spirit wakes on your own island, in Nahvá. Here you may rest forever.
kern.elderlexicon.rest: You step through the door. The grass is wet with dew. You are home.
tower.elderlexicon.revived: You come back to life where you died. The body can barely hold, but something in you now runs on its own: you can enter the flow.
phantur.elderlexicon.first.0.1: Do not fear the height. No one has ever seen the top. Not even I, and I am the one who raised it.
phantur.elderlexicon.first.0.2: You died, %1$s. That is not a punishment. It is only the end of something that had to end.
phantur.elderlexicon.first.0.3: There is an island waiting for you. It has been yours since before you were born. There is no hunger there, no hurry, no one to disappoint.
phantur.elderlexicon.first.0.4: But you came all this way. So climb, if you must. I will be on every step.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.1.0: You again. The tower remembers you. So do I.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.2.0: How many times have you climbed these stairs? I know. You do not.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.3.0: Do you know what wearies me most in the ones who return?
phantur.elderlexicon.again.3.1: It is not the stubbornness. Stubbornness I understand; the whole world is made of it.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.3.2: It is the hope. You always arrive with the same one, untouched, as if the last time had never happened.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.3.3: I keep every one of your attempts. You keep none.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.4.0: The island missed you. I thought you should know.
phantur.elderlexicon.again.5.0: Look at the tower, %1$s. It has not grown any shorter since last time.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern.0.0: Welcome. No one here will ask anything of you.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern.1.1: Not the way things were yours down there: borrowed, wearing out, breaking.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern.1.2: Yours the way a thought is yours. Shape it as you like. It will not grow old.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern.2.0: Listen. Nothing. That is what peace does.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern.3.0: You came home. Do not apologize; everyone does.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.0.0: Sometimes I come here only to watch someone who has stopped fighting. It is beautiful.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.1.0: The wind here comes from nowhere. It does not need to.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.2.0: Down there, someone has already forgotten the sound of your voice.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.2.1: That is not sad. It is how the world heals.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.3.0: Do you know why the island is small?
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.3.1: It is not stinginess of mine. A spirit at peace does not need more than this.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.3.2: The ones who want more... those I find in the tower.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_idle.4.0: Sleep, if you like. Here sleep leads nowhere.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_leave.0.0: Already? The grass has not even grown used to your feet.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_leave.1.0: The road is long. I hope you tire before you arrive.
phantur.elderlexicon.kern_leave.2.0: Go, then. It will be here when you come back. It always is.
phantur.elderlexicon.room.0.0: Another room. Did you think it would be the last?
phantur.elderlexicon.room.1.0: This place did not exist until you arrived. I made it with you in mind.
phantur.elderlexicon.room.2.0: Look closely. You have been here before. Or you will be.
phantur.elderlexicon.room.3.0: Others stopped in this room. Some still are.
phantur.elderlexicon.room.4.0: No window in this tower looks out. They all look in.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.1.0: This step is the same as the last. So will the next one be.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.2.0: Do you count the steps? I did, once. I stopped when I noticed they were counting me back.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.3.0: In the waking world there is a dam in every head.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.3.1: It holds back what you dream, so the world does not come apart every time someone wants something.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.3.2: You died, and yours cracked. Now you want to go back like that, without it.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.3.3: Do you understand what you are asking of me? It is not your life. It is everyone else's world.
phantur.elderlexicon.stairs.5.0: Your steps echo. There is no one else here to hear them. Only me.
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.0.0: Did you think the way was always up?
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.1.0: Go down, then. The tower knows how to go down, too.
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.2.0: Notice how your steps grow lighter.
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.2.1: It is the body remembering that going down is natural.
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.2.2: Climbing was always the strange thing.
phantur.elderlexicon.descent.3.0: Every step down erases one up. Count them, if you like.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.0.0: Do you remember this? I remember it better than you do.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.1.0: Your home. Or what is left of it in your head.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.2.0: The dead always go back to the same places.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.2.1: Not because they want to. Because they know no other.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.2.2: Look closely, %1$s. One of these things is not as you left it.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory.3.0: No one is waiting for you here. No one ever was.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory_wrong.1.0: Are you sure you lived here?
phantur.elderlexicon.memory_wrong.2.0: The house is patient. You are not.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory_wrong.3.0: Every time you are wrong, the house forgets a little of you.
phantur.elderlexicon.memory_wrong.3.1: Soon there will be nothing left to forget.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror.0.0: Look at him. That is how I see you.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror.1.0: He is in no hurry. He only arrives later.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror.2.0: On the other side of the mirror is you, a little late.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror.2.1: He does not know you died. He is still living the moment before.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror.2.2: How long do you think you can stay ahead of him?
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror_caught.0.0: He caught you. He always does.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror_caught.1.0: No one outruns their own step.
phantur.elderlexicon.mirror_caught.2.0: Closer every time. One day he will arrive before you.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.0.0: Read slowly. Dead words do not run away.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.1.0: The old tongue has no power at all.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.1.1: The power is yours. It only frightens you enough to let it out.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.2.0: Before there were words, there was fire.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.2.1: The first ones to speak spoke to it.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.2.2: You have forgotten how. I have not.
phantur.elderlexicon.speech.3.0: I have lent you what you need. Do not grow used to it.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.0.0: Tired? So am I. For so long.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.1.0: Stopping is not giving up. But it is close. Try it a little longer.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.2.0: That's it. Stay. It is much easier than it looks.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.3.0: You stopped, and I felt the relief in your chest.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.3.1: Do not pretend you did not feel it too.
phantur.elderlexicon.still.3.2: That relief is the truest thing that has happened to you since you arrived.
phantur.elderlexicon.door.0.0: It is open. It always was.
phantur.elderlexicon.door.1.0: On the other side, the grass is wet with dew. Do you remember the smell?
phantur.elderlexicon.door.2.0: It is not a trap. I swear by what is left of my name.
phantur.elderlexicon.door.3.0: One step, %1$s. One step, and it is over.
phantur.elderlexicon.door.4.1: I am what stands between your wish and the end of your world.
phantur.elderlexicon.door.4.2: That door is not a defeat. It is the only thing in this tower I made with care.
phantur.elderlexicon.hurt.0.0: It hurts, doesn't it? Down there it would hurt more.
phantur.elderlexicon.hurt.1.0: Your body of vis is coming apart. Do not fight it.
phantur.elderlexicon.hurt.2.0: If you fall here, you fall for real. Think of who would be left.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.1.0: I see everything you could have been. It is all in the windows.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.2.0: Do you think you are the first to believe you are different?
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.3.0: I am in no hurry. You are.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.4.0: There was a woman, long ago, who climbed to where the fog swallows the stone.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.4.1: She talked to herself, so as not to hear my voice.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.4.2: One day she stopped talking. I do not know if it was courage or weariness.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.4.3: She is still up there. Sometimes I visit her.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.5.0: The fire of Lig'dar does not burn. It remembers.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.6.0: When you were a child, you were afraid of the dark.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.6.1: Not of the dark itself, but of what could be in it.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.6.2: It is the same here. The tower is empty. You are the one who fills it.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.7.0: Your name is growing lighter. Have you noticed?
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.8.0: Why go back? Give me one reason, just one, and I will tell you if it is worth a world.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.9.0: I do not lie. I have no need to.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.10.0: Before there was a tower, there was only the volcano. And before the volcano, only the thought of one.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.10.1: I thought it so hard that it happened.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.10.2: That is how everything begins in Nahvá. And that is why nothing born here should go there.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.10.3: There, things have weight. Here, they have will. You want to carry will to where everything weighs.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.11.0: Breathe. Ah. I forgot. You do not need to anymore.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.12.0: Did you hear that? No. Of course not.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.13.0: Every door floating out there is someone who gave up on opening it.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.14.0: I could stop you. I do not. I want the choice to be yours.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.15.0: You are so far from home. And home is so close.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.16.0: The living pray for the dead to rest.
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.16.1: No one ever prays for the dead to return. Have you wondered why?
phantur.elderlexicon.idle.18.0: I had a name before this one. I left it in one of these rooms. If you find it, do not give it back.
phantur.elderlexicon.summit.0.1: Few arrive. Fewer still arrive whole.
phantur.elderlexicon.summit.0.2: The rift is there. Going through it is going back with everything Nahvá gave you, which the waking world does not know how to hold.
phantur.elderlexicon.summit.0.3: I will not stop you. I have never stopped anyone.
phantur.elderlexicon.summit.0.4: I only ask that you look back once, before. The door is still open.
phantur.elderlexicon.rest.0.1: Sleep. I will see to the rest.
phantur.elderlexicon.rest.1.0: Welcome to peace, %1$s. It will not end.
phantur.elderlexicon.rest.2.0: There. There. Now it is over.
phantur.elderlexicon.fall.0.0: Ah. This is not what I wanted for you.
phantur.elderlexicon.fall.1.0: I offered you the island. Remember that, wherever you are going.
phantur.elderlexicon.fall.2.0: You fell. The tower does not weep. I sometimes do.
phantur.elderlexicon.won.0.1: And when the world cracks under your feet, remember that I warned you.
phantur.elderlexicon.won.1.1: I should be angry. I am only tired.
phantur.elderlexicon.won.1.2: Take the broken dam with you. Use it more carefully than I would.

guide.elderlexicon.unwritten: This guide cannot say how this rune is lived. Those who know it did not write how they understood it.
